agent.headline: E.Leclerc experienced a 10.61 z-score complaint spike on Nov 10, 2026, driven by app version 11.0.1 startup crashes and login failures.

actions.expected_effect: Restore app reliability and stop the influx of negative reviews regarding app crashes and login failures
actions.action: Roll back v11.0.1 or immediately issue hotfix v11.0.2 resolving startup crashes and login loop failures
Establish pre-release regression testing for authentication and cold-start flows on iOS and Android
actions.expected_effect: Prevent faulty version updates from reaching production and causing severe z-score spikes

actions.action: Publish an in-app notice and social/store response acknowledging the version 11 login/crash bug with an ETA for the patch
actions.expected_effect: Mitigate customer frustration and reduce churn among loyal card-holders and regular shoppers
